value.title: The 100-Day Kingship Plan Begins
value.synopsis: Xiaoming comes up with the brilliant idea of creating a special menu in honor of King Lie.

value.title: Illiteracy Ruins the Magic Lesson
value.synopsis: After merging, Xiaoming and Lie must find a way to achieve their respective goals.

value.title: The Ultimate Grimoire Appears
value.synopsis: On a mission to find a spellbook, Xiaoming tries out to become a cook.

value.title: A Recipe Too Awful to Watch
value.synopsis: Head Chef Ramsay wants to uncover the secret behind Xiaoming's recipe and sets a trap for him.

value.title: Not a Duel, Just a Stiff Neck
value.synopsis: Xiaoming must prove he memorized the entire spellbook, but his stiff neck won't make it easy.

value.title: King Lie's Cover Blown Too Soon!
value.synopsis: To conquer the kingdom, Xiaoming and company must win the hearts of the people.

value.title: Reborn as the Ultimate Wealthy Tycoon
value.synopsis: Liang will stop at nothing to put Xiaoming out of business and save his own.

value.title: Girls Really Are Brave and Adorable!
value.synopsis: A dangerous prisoner has escaped from the dungeons, and it seems he has a very clear mission.

value.title: Kids, If You Like Someone, Be Bold and Confess!
value.synopsis: They discover Xiaoming's power to create bread. Lei Wan gets him drunk, causing destructive, magical burps.

value.title: Touch My People and You Die!
value.synopsis: Because he helped Xiaoming, Ba comes into conflict with the Captain of the Guard.

value.title: Look Up! There's Gold in the Sky!
value.synopsis: Xiaoming infiltrates the guard post using the captain's corpse and discovers a massive treasure.

value.title: Snagging the District Chief Title!
value.synopsis: Xiaoming wants to buy the District 10 Chief position and discovers just how corrupt the bureaucracy is.

value.title: Reviving District 10
value.synopsis: Xiaoming and Lie seek a way for a district as poor and corrupt as District 10 to prosper.

value.title: Magic for the Masses
value.synopsis: Xiaoming finds a spell for transferring magic, but doesn't know how to perform it.

value.title: Hero Saves the Beauty?! What a Cliché Plot!
value.synopsis: The new mages are beginning their training.

value.title: Then How About a Taste of My Fist?!
value.synopsis: Xiaoming face an enemy immune to magic and physical blows.

value.title: Every Show of Support is a Battle!
value.synopsis: Xiaoming tries to revive Liang, and Lei Wan faces an unexpected attack.

value.title: The Miraculous Cure
value.synopsis: Huang attempts to save Liang, and Xiaoming will have to deal with the death of the District 9 Chief.

value.title: Who Am I?! I'm Your Big Bro!
value.synopsis: Qin Tian wants to see the Chief of District 9, and Xiaoming will have to find a way to deceive him.
